tools.name: check_ai_recommendation
tools.description: Use this when a business owner asks whether ChatGPT or AI recommends their business, whether AI tools like ChatGPT or Perplexity mention or suggest their business, why AI recommends their competitors instead, or how to get their business recommended by AI. It runs a real check: it asks ChatGPT, Perp

tools.name: get_ai_recommendation_result
tools.description: Use this to read the result of a check started with check_ai_recommendation, using the check_id it returned. Returns the status (queued, running, done, failed or refused). When done: for ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini, how many of their answers named the business, which businesses they named instead

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_ai_recommendation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
